title: ImPacks progressive foil tear draft
status: Single-pack motion approved; multi-card opening revised to one pack with three bets in the selected category; production integration pending
assetSource: Exact user-supplied black-and-gold ImPacks wrapper, October 11, 2026. PNG preserved; WebP encodes the same artwork with alpha.

beats.name: Slow tension
beats.motion: Stronger pre-tear shake: up to 4px lateral travel and 2.7-degree rotation, smoothly ramping up and down between 100 and 1450ms

beats.name: First tear
beats.motion: Tear advances from the left notch to 22% width along the seal seam with gentle curves; untouched right side stays sealed

beats.name: Second pull
beats.motion: Tear advances to 65%; released foil curls smoothly toward the viewer, exposing metallic underside

beats.name: Fast final rip
beats.motion: Overlapping final pull finishes at 3380ms; strip smoothly curls away through 3900ms

beats.name: Rarity bloom
beats.motion: Soft rarity bloom and eased particles; reduced rays and no expanding ring

beats.name: Lift out
beats.motion: 156×260px card translates upward 300px through the stationary 192×338px wrapper opening, matching its initial tilt before straightening

beats.name: Spin and reveal
beats.motion: Three full Y-axis spins followed by a final half-turn (1260 degrees total), smoothly accelerating and decelerating. Conceal artwork until the last half-turn.

beats.name: Settle and shimmer
beats.motion: Face-up hold and finite rarity shimmer from 7470 to 8300ms

easing.liftAndFlip: Quintic smootherstep with zero velocity and acceleration at endpoints

rarityCaveat: Illustrative visual treatments only. Current contracts do not define rarity or rarity odds. Do not infer rarity from market probability or order status.
accessibility: Native keyboard controls, phase announcements, pause and skip. Reduced-motion playback goes directly to final card, avoiding shake and spins.
productionHandoff: Animate only returned, server-selected cards. Replay must never repeat a purchase or draw. Preserve quote ownership, retry identity and actual order status. This draft shows one illustrative card; integrate the three returned cards separately.

tearing.path: Heat-seal boundary at 29px in the 192×338 wrapper, with two low-amplitude broad curves; no micro ripples or frayed fibers
tearing.deformation: Perspective-projected textured foil mesh with smooth curl, continuous lighting and silver back face; no animated ripple deformation
tearing.attachment: Only traversed columns detach; all remaining columns retain their original positions
tearing.release: Strip flies away only after the tear reaches the right edge
tearing.scope: Visual approximation of flexible foil; not a physical fracture simulation
tearing.tearFront: Subpixel continuous position; seam shape sampled at 1px

verification: First and second partial tears visually inspected
Full playback, replay and pause checked
Keyboard timeline scrub and rarity preview checked
Inner back wall and gold shimmer visually checked; browser reported no script errors
Mid-reveal inspected: wrapper remains opaque and card does not ghost through; full playback completes
Mid-extraction visually checked: card rises through the mouth while wrapper stays stationary
6.2-second playback and final state checked; script syntax checked
Mid-spin concealment and 1260-degree rotation path inspected; replay and final reveal checked

interior.structure: Narrow 4–7px recessed back-lining sliver tucked directly beneath the torn seam, with subtle pocket shadow; no raised rear flap
interior.visibility: Exposed only where the seam has torn; remains attached to stationary wrapper and fades with empty packaging after the card clears
interior.perspective: Pack rotates on both X and Y as the opening widens

rarityShimmer.motion: Finite smooth reflective sweep from 7470 to 8300ms, with final settle through 8400ms
rarityShimmer.accessibility: Uses the existing scrubbable timeline. No independent looping or flashing; pause freezes shimmer, reduced motion skips to final.
rarityShimmer.interiorIntensity: Softened reflection on the narrow lining; card shimmer retained

continuity: Smoothly ramped stronger shake before the tear; upward extraction and clearance preserved; three full spins then a final half-turn reveal with smooth settling

cardFit.centering: Centered with 18px nominal clearance per side; card initially matches wrapper tilt and straightens as it clears

rendering.mesh: 4px columns × 4 rows, at most 384 triangles instead of 960
rendering.lighting: Shared underside sheen gradient per frame
rendering.status: Update phase text only when it changes

bulk.status: Superseded multiple-pack batch with a one-pack, multi-card prototype
bulk.categoryRule: All three demo bets use the one selected pack category
bulk.sequence: One wrapper shakes and tears once; three fitted cards rise through that seam, fan apart, spin individually and reveal; three result cards share the chosen category
bulk.data: Illustrative bets and rarity styling only; no purchases, orders or random outcomes
bulk.productionBoundary: Animate the three existing server-returned cards from one owned opening. Do not create multiple purchases or change quote/retry identity.
verification: Full one-pack playback revealed exactly three cards
Sports category selection applied to all three result cards
Mobile 390px viewport fits all three fanned cards with no horizontal overflow
